recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic urban portrait framed by intricate currency-style borders and guilloché patterns, featuring a central figure in streetwear and prominent, flowing calligraphic typography that overlaps the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated into a banknote-inspired frame
Calligraphic script providing a soft contrast to hard urban photography
Vertical text elements framing the sides to create a sense of currency value
Strong chiaroscuro lighting on the face creating depth and drama
coreInvariants: Desaturated sepia or grayscale color palette
Intricate currency engraving textures in the borders
Dramatic shadow casting across the eyes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes partially obscured by the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the large script title, then follows the circular flourishes to the secondary text and border details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with textures, borders, and overlapping elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light sepia for highlights and text clarity.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for the intricate border engravings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; values range from pure black to bright white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick downs-strokes and thin up-strokes
Extended swashes and ligatures that wrap around other letters
Circular flourishes on descenders and ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature double-stroked or inline details
Terminal swashes integrate into the background texture

treatment.fill: Solid white to light gray gradient

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of organic, flowing script with rigid, geometric vertical sans-serifs.

preserve: The vertical orientation of side text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary formal flourishes and stroke contrast.
Matches the condensed, heavy vertical metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic urban portrait of a man in a baseball cap and jacket. Frame the image with intricate banknote-style borders, including guilloché patterns and ornate scrollwork. The lighting should be dramatic, casting a shadow over the eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, flowing calligraphic script title across the lower middle section, overlapping the subject. Add vertical condensed sans-serif text within the side borders to mimic currency details.

verificationChecks: Does the script overlap the subject naturally?
Are the borders detailed enough to resemble a banknote?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated?
Is the lighting on the face sufficiently dramatic?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the hat
Exact text content from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeding in the monochrome palette
Check that the script flourishes don't obscure the face
Verify the vertical text is aligned within the border ribbons
Confirm the guilloché patterns are crisp and not blurred
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Banknote Border + Calligraphic Overlay + Monochromatic High Contrast
